description: This file defines a Java interface for data access operations related to digital products within the sales manager system. It declares a method to retrieve a DigitalProduct by associated Product and MerchantStore.

classes.name: DigitalProductDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for performing data operations related to DigitalProduct entities in the database.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a specific Product within a MerchantStore.
